question_text: Explain how using an Account.withdraw(amount) interface rather than editing its balance everywhere can help preserve valid state.

solution: The class can validate each withdrawal and enforce an invariant, such as rejecting an amount that exceeds the available balance. Clients use the same rule through the interface, reducing inconsistent direct updates.
